propositions: The provenance test asserts the raw Jira key (RBJNAZV-1) against a lowercased local id (jira-rbjnazv-1) using case-sensitive substring matching, making the assertion fail even when ticket creation succeeds
The ticket payload does not carry the raw Jira key except as a title fallback; the actual DC↔local correspondence is stored only in the binding store, which list_tickets does not return
The test must assert against the exact local id derived from _jira_key_to_local_id(remote_key) and verify the binding store maps that local id to the remote key
The live DC harness job previously converged on an empty store and hit earlier setup failures, masking the oracle defect until the PAT-cap fix unblocked the test suite
Inbound create functionality cannot be proven or disproven until the provenance test's assertions match the actual output shape that the inbound path produces
